patch.value: Detect calibration population and explicit-label drift without inference

Compare current task/type/input-bucket distributions and later explicit labels against a frozen calibration cohort. Acceptance: unchanged cohort stays below predeclared thresholds; shifted fixture trips them; sparse labels report insufficient evidence; zero inference calls; exact model/question digest binding; bounded typed SDK and CLI with remedies; non-git public-copy validation.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap rechecked against installed CLI 2026.10.25 and pinned SDK 2026.10.20, sibling README surfaces and pm-jev calibration/replay implementations. CLI owns tracker reads, authoring, formatting and status roles; no calibration-population sentry found. Calibration binds model/question identity; replay compares policies; pm-rl owns training and promotion. This feature only computes read-only cohort distribution/error diagnostics. No imports, exports, sync, journal, claims, checkpoint or shared-state mutations are introduced, so retry/CAS and native-state migration contracts are not on its path. Strict versioned input carries frozen thresholds and exact identity; no provider adapter. Planned checks: shifted/unchanged/sparse-label fixtures, digest mismatch, dense finite bounded schema fuzz, 500 seeded replay/serialization operation sequences, non-git CLI with no git in PATH, SDK-read public tracker copy with unchanged artifact hash. Full npm/Bun release gates will run in CI at unchanged thresholds.

value.text:
Producer -> cutoff consumer inventory (review class audit; all decision comparisons delegate to threshold.ts compareThreshold/acceptsThreshold):

| Producer | Fit / consumer | Shared representation / end-to-end evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Raw title/description/body/tag/file Dice counts, weighted 0.65/0.30/0.05 | qualityObservation -> qualityFrontier/fitQualityPolicy -> qualityLexicalAccepts in runPairDedupe | Portable exact numerator/denominator; no display number enters new raw-pair fits. 500 raw populations, all three arms and every frontier point; real no-git command alpha case. |
| Raw trigram/title/structural retrieval counts | candidatePairs ranking; historical lexical benchmark fitPairCutoff -> pairMetrics | Exact channel comparison and ranking; historical benchmark intentionally fits and reapplies the identical numeric candidate-score view, never reconstructs a weighted lexical ratio. 500 regenerated raw retrieval populations. No fitted cutoff controls retrieval itself. |
| Raw duplicate/related Noul probabilities | fitPairCutoff -> pairVerdict/pairMetrics | Stored-decimal rationals; 1000 raw probability populations for both targets, including disabled results. |
| Raw Choice distributions, exact top-two margin | fitTypeMargin -> resolveTriageType; fixed link margin gate | Same marginValue + comparator. 1000 raw populations, JSON/TOON; noisy four-row fixed case retained. Link margin is predeclared, not fitted. |
| Raw probabilities -> temperature scaling | calibrateObservations -> calibratedAnswer -> triage/priority/precreate/link probability guards | Same scaleProbabilities output on both sides, interpreted as stored-decimal rational. 100 raw channel populations, fitting and runtime scaling independently reapplied; JSON/TOON. Temperature/NLL are floating transforms, not count-derived cutoffs. |
| Raw Noul -> observe confidence and gate probability | deriveThreshold/family reports -> observe/gatePoint | Same chosen-label confidence producer for diagnostics; numeric boundary counted with the same comparator. 1000 raw populations. These diagnostic fits do not authorize runtime mutations. |
| Raw typed answer probabilities + labels + retrieval eligibility | selectAbstentionPolicy -> abstainWithPolicy | Same stored-decimal confidence and fixed 0.05 grid; exact weighted count costs. 1000 mixed raw duplicate/type populations. |
| Raw cohort categories and later explicit labels | checkCalibrationDrift | Exact TV/error-rate differences vs declared decimal cutoffs, no fitted cutoff. Existing 6000 raw count/cohort cases plus serialized fixed inclusive review cases; no inference. |
| Recorded raw choice/score/Noul answers | replayDecisions | Shared exact comparator, exact Noul complement. User-supplied probability policy, no fitter; existing raw replay tests. |
| Text BM25/embedding cosine -> exemplar top-K; precreate token counts -> candidate ordering; budgets/limits/revisions | retrieval/eligibility and safety guards | No fitted cutoff consumer; fixed ranking or integer safety bounds. Covered by existing raw retrieval/SDK tests. |

Historical scalar quality observations and published numeric cutoffs remain literal decimal inputs for receipt replay. They cannot reconstruct the original rational score; new raw collection uses qualityObservation and persists the portable exact score. Model-only/lexical-only/combined use the same supplied evidence representation. No model calls or dependency pin changes are needed.
